title: Solicitors' conduct rules amended to fit AML/CTF obligations
summary: From 1 July 2026, new Legal Services Council rules deal with conflicts between solicitors' AML/CTF obligations and their ethical duties, including confidentiality and loyalty to clients.
what_changes: Solicitors must only accept and follow lawful, proper and competent client instructions.
The rules clarify when a solicitor may have just cause to terminate an engagement.
Retainer agreements should explain relevant statutory disclosure obligations and when a retainer may need to be terminated.
who_it_applies_to: Solicitors and law practices in Uniform Law states, in particular those with AML/CTF obligations.

history.event: VLSB+C reported that Legal Services Council rules on AML/CTF and professional duties commenced on 1 July 2026.
